FETtec G4 35A AIO Flight Controller.ndaa_note: FETtec GmbH, Germany (+49 2263). EU-manufactured. Allied-nation NDAA compliant.

JHEMCU F7-XSD Pro DJI Flight Controller.name: JHEMCU F7-XSD Pro DJI Flight Controller - Mini 20x20 - Standard
JHEMCU F7-XSD Pro DJI Flight Controller.description: The JHEMCU F7-XSD Pro Flight Controller is designed with DJI pilots in mind! This standard version F7 FC is ultra-light at 4.7g and handles up to 6S batteries.

JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controlle.name: JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controller - Mini 20x20 - Standard
JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controlle.description: The JHEMCU NOXE F4 V2 Flight Controller is made with DJI Pilots in mind. This standard version FC packs 2 UARTs, and a BEC into a mini-sized 20x20 board with 3-6S capabilities!

JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controlle.name: JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controller - Mini 20x20 - Deluxe
JHEMCU NOXE F411 V2 DJI Flight Controlle.description: The JHEMCU NOXE F4 V2 Flight Controller is made with DJI Pilots in mind. This Deluxe FC packs a 16MB Blackbox, Barometer, 2 UARTs, and BEC into a mini-sized 20x20 board with 3-6S capabilities!

JHEMCU AIO Board - GSF405A F4 FC + 5A 1-.name: JHEMCU AIO Board - GSF405A F4 FC + 5A 1-2S ESC w/ Built-in ELRS 2.4GHz Receiver
JHEMCU AIO Board - GSF405A F4 FC + 5A 1-.description: The JHEMCU GS405A AIO features an F4 FC and a 5A ESC with built-in ELRS 2.4GHz receiver. This is an ultra-light 3.3g brushless AIO flight controller with 25.5x25.5mm mounting pattern!! This FC can handle 5A of continuous current and up to 2S.

T-Motor F7 PRO Flight Controller w/ WiFi.name: T-Motor F7 PRO Flight Controller w/ WiFi + Bluetooth
T-Motor F7 PRO Flight Controller w/ WiFi.description: T-Motor's F7 Pro Flight Controller has arrived! Enjoy full function in a wireless state! Great for cinematic professional use. This FC features 8 UARTS, WiFi and Bluetooth capabilites, and a 30.5x30.5 mounting pattern.

XILO Stax V2 F4 Flight Controller.name: XILO Stax V2 F4 Flight Controller
XILO Stax V2 F4 Flight Controller.description: The XILO Stax V2 F4 Flight Controller combines powerful F4 processing power with a host of features such as receiver mounting and VTX remote power switching. Plug n' play allows stacking with your favorite 4-in-1 ESC.

Axisflying F722 DJI Flight Controller w/.name: Axisflying F722 DJI Flight Controller w/ OSD - Mini 20x20
Axisflying F722 DJI Flight Controller w/.description: The Axisflying F722 Flight Controller is plug-and-play compatible for both Analog and HD and easily connects to a DJI FPV Air Unit. This FC has a 20x20 mounting pattern and features an MPU6000 Gyro, QMP6988 Barometer, and 5V 3A BEC.

Flywoo GN405 20A AIO BL_S Flight Control.name: Flywoo GN405 20A AIO BL_S Flight Controller

Flywoo's new GOKU series AIO are finally here! The GOKU GN405 20A FC is an economical and durable all-in-one AIO, which can meet most of your FPV needs.

Flywoo Gn405 20A Aio Stack Hm850 Vtx.description:

T-Motor Mini Racer 20x20 F7 Flight Contr.name: T-Motor Mini Racer 20x20 F7 Flight Controller
T-Motor Mini Racer 20x20 F7 Flight Contr.description: The T-Motor Mini Racer F7 is a 3-6S 20x20 mini flight controller with a 16MB Blackbox flash memory, 5V.2A BEC, and an MPU6000 gyro. Designed for easy maintenance and low interference.
T-Motor Mini Racer 20x20 F7 Flight Contr.ndaa_note: T-Motor (Tiger Motor Co., Ltd.), Guangzhou, China. Non-NDAA.

HGLRC DJI Zeus F722 Mini 3-6S F7 Flight.name: HGLRC DJI Zeus F722 Mini 3-6S F7 Flight Controller

iFlight SucceX-D F7 TwinG V2.2 F722 Flig.name: iFlight SucceX-D F7 TwinG V2.2 F722 Flight Controller - HD Version
iFlight SucceX-D F7 TwinG V2.2 F722 Flig.description: The iFlight SucceX-D F7 V2.2 is a 30.5x30.5 flight controller that has an F722 MCU and is designed to work seamlessly with DJI’s HD FPV system.

iFlight Beast F7 V2 55A AIO 25.5x25.5mm.name: iFlight Beast F7 V2 55A AIO 25.5x25.5mm Flight Controller

FETtec FC G4 v1.7 Flight Controller.name: FETtec FC G4 v1.7 Flight Controller
FETtec FC G4 v1.7 Flight Controller.description: The FETtec FC G4 v1.7 features the latest STM32G4 processor. Providing unparalleled processing power to your aircraft. Zeez V2 F7 3-6S 20x20 Flight Controller.name: Zeez V2 F7 3-6S 20x20 Flight Controller
Zeez V2 F7 3-6S 20x20 Flight Controller.description: The Zeez F7 V2 2020 is an 8-Motor Output Flight Controller including an F7 processor designed with top-of-the-line hardware. Qualcomm QRB5165 with PX4 running directly on the DSP — no separate FC required. 15+ TOPS AI compute (Hexagon HTA + GPU + DSP + NPU), 8 GB LPDDR5, 7 concurrent MIPI-CSI cameras. VIO, obstacle avoidance, SLAM, ROS 2, Docker, TensorFlow Lite onboard. Only 16g. Assembled in USA.
ModalAI VOXL 2.companion_processor: Qualcomm QRB5165 (8 cores up to 3.09 GHz)
ModalAI VOXL 2.npu: Qualcomm Hexagon HTA + GPU + DSP + NPU
ModalAI VOXL 2.ndaa_note: ModalAI Inc., San Diego CA. US-made VOXL 2 autopilot. Blue UAS Framework listed. NDAA compliant.

Orqa DTK APB.name: Orqa DTK APB
Orqa DTK APB.description: Single-board platform combining STM32H7 flight controller with NXP i.MX8M Plus companion computer. Collapses the traditional FC + separate companion model into one board. NPU (2.3 TOPS) enables onboard AI, vision processing, and autonomous operation. PCIe expansion slot for DTK ecosystem modules. Primary development hardware for AI Wingman onboard intelligence layer.
Orqa DTK APB.companion_processor: NXP i.MX8M Plus (4× Cortex-A53 @ 1.8 GHz + Cortex-M7 @ 800 MHz co-proc)
Orqa DTK APB.wingman_role: Primary onboard AI development platform — FC + companion + NPU inference in one board

schema_data.features: FC + companion computer on single board. Onboard AI inference. MAVLink bridge built-in.
schema_data.pinout_notes: All-in-one board. No separate companion computer wiring needed. Direct Ethernet and serial between FC and companion.

Auterion Skynode S.name: Auterion Skynode S
Auterion Skynode S.description: All-in-one autopilot and mission computer on a 30.5mm board. FMUv6x FC (STM32H7) + dedicated NPU mission computer in a chip-down design. Blue UAS Framework listed. Single connection to most quad ESCs (signals and power, up to 8 motors/servos). Works out-of-the-box with USB cameras, supports 2 MIPI cameras. Runs AuterionOS (PX4-based), deploying AI/CV apps via app store model. Combat-proven in Ukraine. Direct 8S LiPo/LiIon input without power module.
Auterion Skynode S.companion_processor: Dedicated NPU mission computer (custom Auterion chip-down design)
Auterion Skynode S.camera_inputs: 2× MIPI CSI + USB cameras (out of box)
Auterion Skynode S.expansion: 8× motor/servo outputs, standard 30.5mm mount, payload connectors
Auterion Skynode S.ndaa_note: Auterion Inc., San Francisco CA (Swiss-founded, US HQ). NDAA compliant. Enterprise PX4 platform.

ARK FPV Flight Controller.name: ARK FPV Flight Controller
ARK FPV Flight Controller.description: NDAA-compliant FPV flight controller based on ARKV6X in a 30.5mm pattern. STM32H743 at 480 MHz, industrial IIM-42653 IMU, barometer, magnetometer. 3–12S battery input with regulated 12V 2A output for VTX and payloads — the key differentiator for FPV builds. Ships with PX4, also supports ArduPilot and Betaflight. Blue UAS Framework listed. Made in USA in ISO9001/AS9001D facilities. 1W heater for cold-weather ops. Not a companion computer — included here as the FPV-optimized NDAA alternative to Orqa FC stack.
ARK FPV Flight Controller.connectivity: USB-C, PWM, UART, SPI, CAN, I2C, MicroSD
ARK FPV Flight Controller.note: FC only — no companion computer. Categorized here as the Blue UAS Framework FPV-optimized NDAA alternative alongside integrated stacks.
ARK FPV Flight Controller.ndaa_note: ARK Electronics, USA. Designed and manufactured USA. NDAA compliant.
